c1-tudomanyelmelet-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Knowing More Than We Say
c1-tudomanyelmelet-01.scenario: In a study group on the philosophy of science, you are asked what Polányi Mihály meant by tacit knowledge.
c1-tudomanyelmelet-01.prompt: Tell the group what tacit knowledge means.
cues: Say what we cannot do with it
c1-tudomanyelmelet-01.target: A hallgatólagos tudás azt jelenti, hogy többet tudunk, mint amennyit szavakkal ki tudunk fejezni.
c1-tudomanyelmelet-01.english: Tacit knowledge means that we know more than we can express in words.
c1-tudomanyelmelet-01.canDo: I can explain what Michael Polanyi meant by tacit knowledge (*hallgatólagos tudás*).

c1-tudomanyelmelet-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Core and Belt
c1-tudomanyelmelet-02.scenario: In a study group on the philosophy of science, someone asks how Lakatos Imre described a research programme.
c1-tudomanyelmelet-02.prompt: Tell the group what the hard core and the protective belt are in Lakatos's theory.
cues: Say what the hard core is
Say what the protective belt does
c1-tudomanyelmelet-02.target: A kemény mag a program érinthetetlen alapja, a védőöv pedig segédhipotézisekkel felfogja a cáfolatokat.
c1-tudomanyelmelet-02.english: The hard core is the untouchable base of the programme, and the protective belt catches refutations with auxiliary hypotheses.
c1-tudomanyelmelet-02.canDo: I can use the terms hard core (*kemény mag*) and protective belt (*védőöv*) to describe a theory.

c1-tudomanyelmelet-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Memory and Data Together
c1-tudomanyelmelet-03.scenario: In a study group, the talk turns to Neumann János and the computer.
c1-tudomanyelmelet-03.prompt: Tell the group what the Neumann architecture means.
cues: Say who the idea is named after
c1-tudomanyelmelet-03.target: A Neumann-architektúra azt jelenti, hogy a program és az adatok közös memóriában vannak; Neumann Jánosról nevezték el.
c1-tudomanyelmelet-03.english: The Neumann architecture means that the program and the data are in a common memory; it is named after János Neumann.
c1-tudomanyelmelet-03.canDo: I can explain John von Neumann's (Neumann János) role in computing and game theory.

c1-tudomanyelmelet-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Science and Society
c1-tudomanyelmelet-04.scenario: In a study group, a member says that science is completely free of values.
c1-tudomanyelmelet-04.prompt: Tell the group why many scholars doubt this.
cues: Say what researchers should do about it
c1-tudomanyelmelet-04.target: A társadalmi viszonyok befolyásolják, hogy mit kutatnak, ezért a kutatónak fel kell ismernie saját elfogultságait.
c1-tudomanyelmelet-04.english: Social conditions influence what is researched, so researchers must recognise their own biases.
c1-tudomanyelmelet-04.canDo: I can explain why many scholars doubt that science can be fully free of values.

c1-tudomanyelmelet-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Limits of Gene Editing
c1-tudomanyelmelet-05.scenario: In a study group, the talk turns to gene editing and its limits.
c1-tudomanyelmelet-05.prompt: Tell the group why many people ask for limits on gene editing.
cues: Name the principle people refer to
c1-tudomanyelmelet-05.target: Sokan attól tartanak, hogy a következmények visszafordíthatatlanok, ezért az elővigyázatosság elvére hivatkoznak.
c1-tudomanyelmelet-05.english: Many fear that the consequences are irreversible, so they refer to the precautionary principle.
c1-tudomanyelmelet-05.canDo: I can explain why many people ask for ethical limits on gene editing, AI and biotechnology.

c1-tudomanyelmelet-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Views of Knowledge
c1-tudomanyelmelet-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the study group, you compare two thinkers you have read.
c1-tudomanyelmelet-consolidation.prompt: Compare in a sentence or two what Polányi and Lakatos each stressed.
c1-tudomanyelmelet-consolidation.target: Polányi a személyes és hallgatólagos tudást hangsúlyozta, Lakatos a kutatási programokat.
c1-tudomanyelmelet-consolidation.english: Polányi stressed personal and tacit knowledge, Lakatos the research programmes.
c1-tudomanyelmelet-consolidation.canDo: I can compare how Polanyi and Lakatos described scientific knowledge.
